title: Creamy Chorizo Pasta
subtitle: One pot · ready in 20 minutes
description: Garlicky, smoky and creamy — a comforting one-pot pasta that comes together in under 20 minutes with just a handful of ingredients.

steps.title: Soften the aromatics
steps.text: Place a deep skillet or frying pan on medium heat and drizzle with olive oil. Add the garlic and onion and fry until softened.

steps.title: Brown the chorizo
steps.text: Add the chorizo and fry for a few minutes until it releases its oils and colours the pan.
steps.note: Want a richer sauce? Add 1 tbsp tomato paste and fry it with the onion, garlic and chorizo.

steps.title: Simmer the pasta
steps.text: Stir in the paprika, dried oregano, 500ml of the chicken stock (keep the rest to top up) and the dried pasta — it should be just covered by the liquid. Put the lid on and simmer, stirring occasionally so it doesn't stick, until the pasta is nearly al dente. Add a splash more stock if it looks dry.

steps.title: Make it creamy
steps.text: Take off the lid and stir in the cream and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Simmer until the sauce thickens slightly and the pasta finishes cooking.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Once it's as saucy as you like and the pasta is al dente, divide between bowls and top with grated parmesan and finely sliced chives. Enjoy!
